  "phoneNote": "The prominent venue photo and readable typography work well, but repeated opening-hours information bloats the lower page and the reservation action lacks emphasis.",
  "desktopNote": "The photo-led hero feels specific to this restaurant, but oversized section padding and the narrow, left-aligned menu leave substantial unused space.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate opening hours into one block on phone; remove the duplicate reservation note and the repeated hours block in the footer.",
    "Give the phone reservation action the same filled-button treatment as desktop, with the directions link as a quieter secondary action beside or directly beneath it.",
    "Reduce desktop section padding and arrange the two menu categories in balanced columns to eliminate the large empty right-hand area."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone opening-hours section repeats the same reservation note twice, and the footer repeats the opening-hours block."
  ]
}
